## Status Assessment

✅ **Champion stable** - v5_latest maintaining lead with better risk profile  
✅ **Clean queue** - No INCONCLUSIVE candidates blocking  
✅ **System healthy** - 83 loops completed, ~1.5 days compute remaining

1. **Candidate tradeoff**: `exp_macro_alpha_shadow` shows better lockbox consistency (min 1.35 vs 1.13) but unacceptable tuning floor (0.05) and drawdown (-11.2%)


Ready to continue when resumed. 🔄
